prompt: It is your first week in junior high. Write a short passage to introduce your new school. Use 'There is / There are' and adjectives (big, new, kind...).
promptCn: 开学第一周,写一段话介绍你的新学校。用 There is / There are 和形容词(big, new, kind…)。

l2: There is a {adj} {place}, and there are two playgrounds.
The classrooms are clean and bright.
My teacher {teacher} is kind and friendly.
l3: Welcome to my new school! Its name is {schoolName}.
There is a {adj} {place} near our classroom, and there are two big playgrounds outside.
The classrooms are clean and bright, and there are tall green trees around us.
My teacher {teacher} is kind and patient, and my new classmates are friendly. I really like it here!
